aws.title: S3 bucket allows public read access
aws.description: Bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to Principal *
aws.remediation: Remove public ACLs and bucket policies that allow public read. Enable Block Public Access.
aws.iac_snippet:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "example" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id
  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

aws.title: IAM role has overly permissive policy
aws.description: Attached policy allows Action: * on Resource: *
aws.remediation: Replace with least-privilege policy scoped to required services and resources.
aws.iac_snippet: # Use IAM policy generator or AWS IAM Access Analyzer recommendations

aws.title: RDS instance not encrypted at rest
aws.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. Requires snapshot and restore for existing instances.

aws.title: Security group allows unrestricted SSH (0.0.0.0/0:22)
aws.description: Inbound rule permits TCP 22 from anywhere
aws.remediation: Restrict SSH source to known corporate CIDRs or use Session Manager / bastion.

aws.framework: EU AI Act / Internal AI Policy
aws.title: Bedrock model invocation not logged to CloudTrail
aws.description: No data events enabled for Bedrock in CloudTrail trail
aws.remediation: Enable CloudTrail data events for bedrock.amazonaws.com

azure.title: Storage account allows public blob access
azure.remediation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess to false and review existing containers.

azure.title: VM disks not encrypted with customer-managed key
azure.description: OS and data disks use platform-managed keys only
azure.remediation: Enable Azure Disk Encryption with CMK from Key Vault.

azure.title: Owner role assigned to user principal at subscription scope
azure.description: User has Owner instead of more restrictive custom role
azure.remediation: Replace with least-privilege custom role; use PIM for just-in-time elevation.

azure.framework: EU AI Act / Internal AI Policy
azure.title: Azure OpenAI content filter not set to strict
azure.description: Default content filter severity is Medium
azure.remediation: Configure content filters to High for hate, sexual, violence, self-harm categories.

sap.title: Critical authorization object S_TCODE open for *
sap.description: Role Z_ALL_ACCESS grants S_TCODE with TCD = * to multiple users
sap.remediation: Remove wildcard TCD; assign only required transaction codes. Review via SUIM.

sap.title: login/password_downwards_compatibility = 1
sap.description: Allows older hash algorithms; weakens password security
sap.remediation: Set login/password_downwards_compatibility = 0 and force password reset for affected users.

sap.framework: EU AI Act / SAP AI Policy
sap.title: Joule / AI agent lacks documented risk classification
sap.description: No formal AI risk rating recorded in AI Agent Hub or equivalent registry
sap.remediation: Register agent, complete risk assessment, and attach architecture decision record.

sap.title: Production client changeable (SCC4)
sap.description: Client 100 is set to 'Changes without automatic recording' in production
sap.remediation: Set production client to 'No changes allowed' and enforce transport-only changes.
